factions.name: The Kuharm Moot
factions.ethos: Lords and levies who hold the roads and tithe the harvest; proud, slow to trust, quick to take offence.

factions.name: The Maukarn Concord
factions.ethos: A council of guild towns that trades first and fights when trade fails; polite, counting, never forgetting a debt.

factions.name: The Ashwrights
factions.ethos: Miners and smelters of the burning lands: they tap lava, quarry basalt and sell iron to anyone. Blunt, fair in a deal, ruthless with the land.

factions.name: The Green Choir
factions.ethos: Druids who sing the wild back over ruins: they would let forest swallow every town. Gentle in speech, implacable in purpose.

factions.name: The Hollow Court
factions.ethos: The dead that did not lie down, and the living who serve them; they want the world quiet, dark and theirs. Courteous, cold, patient.

factions.name: The Salt Fleet
factions.ethos: Raiders and salvagers of the coasts in patched hulls; loyal to their crews, nothing else. Loud, greedy, superstitious about the sea.
